# bacnet_ede v0.1.1 - Table of Contents

BACnetEDE is a BACnet EDE File parser and writer. EDE stands for Engineering Data Exchange.

## Modules

- [BACnetEDE](BACnetEDE.md): BACnetEDE is a BACnet EDE File parser and writer. EDE stands for Engineering Data Exchange.
- [BACnetEDE.CSV](BACnetEDE.CSV.md): Default CSV parser and encoder for this library.
It uses CRLF `\r\n` line separator and semicolons `;` as separator.

- [BACnetEDE.ObjectTypes](BACnetEDE.ObjectTypes.md): The Object Types contain a number of rows or data, identified by its reference number,
listing an enumeration of BACnet object types.
BACnet object types are defined by the ASHRAE 135 BACnet protocol standard.
- [BACnetEDE.Project](BACnetEDE.Project.md): The `Project` is the main struct and contains the project information as included in the EDE.
- [BACnetEDE.Project.Object](BACnetEDE.Project.Object.md): The object struct identifies an object of the EDE.
- [BACnetEDE.StateTexts](BACnetEDE.StateTexts.md): The State Texts contains a number of rows or data, identified by its reference number,
listing an enumeration of state texts for multistate objects or binary objects
(only inactive and active texts).
Multistate and binary texts must not be mixed under one reference number.
- [BACnetEDE.Units](BACnetEDE.Units.md): The Units contain a number of rows or data, identified by its reference number,
listing an enumeration of BACnet engineering units. BACnet engineering units
are defined by the ASHRAE 135 BACnet protocol standard.
